reason: The cited lines show the tool returns the current browser page URL, title, and an ARIA/page snapshot via socket messages. This does not show arbitrary host code execution, nor delivery of agent-supplied data to an attacker-readable destination. The returned browser page content/title/URL can be attacker-controlled web content, so UNTRUSTED is supported. The lines do not establish that the page is non-public, authenticated, file://, localhost, or intranet content, so SECRET is insufficient.
